profile.summary: FloWater makes and installs water refill stations that filter and purify tap water. Its stations are used in businesses, schools, fitness centers, hotels and homes. The company is based in Denver, Colorado and has been part of the Swedish company Bluewater Group since 2022.

review.notes: Same organization: FloWater, Denver CO, and its Our Company page says it installed refill stations in Oakland Unified School District. Legal name, address, email, HQ and website are confirmed on the contact page, but the summary calls Bluewater Group 'Swedish', which neither cited page says (the company page only says it joined forces with Bluewater in 2022; bluewatergroup.com is Stockholm-based but does not mention FloWater), so the summary is not fully supported by its cited sources.
